title: Lookout Mountain CIA facility in Laurel Canyon
place_text: Lookout Mountain, Laurel Canyon, Los Angeles

tellings.quote: Um, and as you point out, Lookout Mountain is a CIA facility in Laurel Canyon and the whole history of drugs and the government and Vietnam and espionage and all this kind of stuff.

related.note: Both are lore about the same Lookout Mountain facility in Laurel Canyon. This telling makes it the Manhattan Project's film lab in the 1940s, while the story makes it a CIA facility.

plain: Lookout Mountain, in the Laurel Canyon area of Los Angeles, is said to have been a facility of the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, tied to a long story of drugs, government, the Vietnam War and spying in the 1960s. A researcher named Eric Weinstein says this, agreeing with a point the host had made ("as you point out"), and names no other source.
